findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The response is missing the 'content-security-policy' header.
findings.evidence: Response headers: access-control-allow-origin, age, alt-svc, cache-control, cf-cache-status, cf-ray, connection, content-disposition, content-encoding, content-security-policy-report-only, content-t
findings.impact: Without CSP, injected scripts run freely, worsening XSS impact.
findings.remediation: Add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header.

findings.title: Wildcard CORS policy (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
findings.description: The server allows any origin to read responses.
findings.evidence: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
findings.impact: Any website can read responses (higher risk if the endpoint returns sensitive data).
findings.remediation: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to a trusted allowlist of origins.
